Chapter 6023: Don’T Let Ignorance Define You

Chapter 6023: Don’t Let Ignorance Define You

The labyrinth of fog and weathering aura did not affect Li Qiye and Sky Step King due to the eye’s illuminating beam showing them the proper path.

“How can this be?!” Spectators didn’t believe their own eyes.

“What is this treasure?” An ancestor from Immortal Suppression considered the statue to be an incredible treasure.

“This is possible?” Goldvase Angel, the manager from Splendor Square, and their juniors became astonished.

They were familiar with this decorative statue placed in the middle of a field. They saw it every day and thought nothing of it.

“So this was a treasure all along.” Goldvase murmured.

He saw the summoning of the monsters and the safe barrier previously. Now, it seemed capable of bypassing the oblivion domain as well.

“I heard that when the grand momentum broke down to chaos, the ruins would turn into a perilous zone. So this thing can unseal it.” The manager added.

He knew several legends regarding the immortal palaces. They were dragged here from another location by Splendor Monarch. Within them was a terrible power.

Although they were broken, shells of their former selves, the terrible power of oblivion remained. It could trap someone forever while grinding their lifespan.

“You haven’t opened this before?” Minisun asked.

Goldvase and the manager shook their head at the same time. As ancestors, they have stuck around for a long time and never saw the statue opening its eye.

“We probably couldn’t open it even if we had known.” Goldvase sighed. The question was - did their progenitor know about it? Perhaps not.

“Who is the young noble?” Goldvase quietly asked Minisun.

The manager wondered as well. He had met Li Qiye back in Radiant Longevity School and didn’t fully understand Li Qiye’s true potential. It was a different story now.

“What is that statue?” Meanwhile, Omni and Allmountain observed the journey.

“It can dispel the oblivion domain, it has to be related to the ruins.” Allmountain said.

“Left behind by the immortals? What do you know about the immortals, Dao Brother?” Omni asked.

Immortal Suppression Dynasty had always supported Zhan Sansheng. Some said he was their founder. His three iterations’ purpose was to cut down these immortals.

As the dynasty followed Moshi, Dingtian, and Poye to battle, it should know more about these immortals than anyone.

“Very little.” Allmountain answered: “It might be on the same level as the six treasures.”

Omni couldn’t tell whether he was unwilling to speak or didn’t know the truth.

With the eye as their helper, Li Qiye and Sky Step climbed up to the top palace.

“They’re inside.” Spectators became emotional and didn’t miss a single second.

“See how easy that was?” Li Qiye could touch the sky now given the high position. He looked down and said: “Don’t let ignorance define you.”

Listeners below trembled with rage and turned red. Everyone had an ugly expression but how could they retort when he successfully performed the feat?

“Fellow Daoist, thank you for enlightening us.” Allmountain said: “You have won this round and deserve the title of the greatest mortal.”

“Title aside, I can grab any of these treasures now. You all wanted them, right?” Li Qiye smiled.

As the crowd was livid by their inability to ascend, the duo took a closer look at the treasures.

Li Qiye shook his head and smiled while gazing at them.

“Young Noble, I believe two out of the six are left behind by Supreme Immortal Ancestor.” Sky Step was emotional since he never thought he could stand so close to these mythical artifacts.

“Supreme Immortal Ancestor? Never heard of this title before.” Li Qiye was surprised. [1]

“A legendary and ancient existence, rumored to be stronger than the famed immortals.” Sky Step explained.

1. I went literal here but I wanted Supreme Primogenitor or Supreme Patriarch at first. Playing it safe by going word for word here ☜
